title: Benchmarking state-of-the-art sodium-ion battery cells – Modeling energy density and carbon footprint at gigafactory-scale

Sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) are on the verge of mass adoption, with several players striving for gigafactory-scale production. Uncertainty remains regarding their competitiveness with lithium-ion batteries (LIBs). This study addresses this...
